allowedSemanticFields.instructions: For these five moves only, supply the source-correct moveKind, respondsToIds and responseComponents, plus rationale. A reply must actually address a premise/inference/conclusion of an earlier selected move. A speaker introducing a counterargument against the opponent's book is not automatically replying to a different argument in the opponent's current opening. If constructive, BOTH arrays must be empty. Preserve all genuine later reply chains. Existing responseComponents may be retained unchanged when justified.

The current morality section has 5 pro and 3 con moves, so violates maximum 4 per side. Choose a minimal source-grounded resection of at most two existing moves, preferably one coherent pro/con exchange together, into an existing semantically appropriate section. Both origin and destination must have at least 1 and at most 4 per side afterward. No moves may be dropped, split, merged, added or semantically rewritten; no section identities, titles or weights may change. Each reassignment needs >=40 characters of source-specific reasoning. Do not arbitrarily shift one side just to force symmetry. If impossible within this scope, report blocked rather than widen it.

After your proposed section assignments, supply a source-specific overall selectionBalanceRationale and a capacityRationale for every existing section in original order. Explicitly justify distinct non-mergeable fourth cards wherever a side has 4. Give no formulaic numerical symmetry justification. The controller will compute all arithmetic itself.
